Java Concurrent Banking System Simulation
10

Problem Statement:
Write a Java program that simulates a multi-threaded banking system where multiple users can deposit and withdraw money from a shared bank account. The program should use threads and synchronization to ensure that the operations are handled safely without race conditions. 
Input Description:
The initial balance of the bank account.
Number of users (threads) performing transactions.
Each user specifies a transaction type (Deposit/Withdraw) and amount. 
Output Description:
The transactions performed by each user.
The final account balance after all transactions. 
Sample Input:
1000
3
Deposit 500
Withdraw 700
Withdraw 1000 
Sample Output:
Deposited 500. New Balance: 1500
Withdrawn 700. New Balance: 800
Insufficient funds! Withdrawal of 1000 failed.
Final Balance: 800
